text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, returning it then.
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(...That student just now likes that book.
If I could talk with her, maybe we could become friends—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (—But what if I startle them? What if they don't share the excitement? Ugh...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—Excuse me? Hey, excuse me!
I'd really like to borrow that book!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah—yes, right away!
I'll be right there...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Huh— This book, "The Complete Encyclopedia of Magic"...?
Does that mean this person is also into fantasy—)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...?
What is it, staring at me like that?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah♪ Don't tell me
you wanna become a witch too!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heheh♪ Then from now on, we're rivals!
'Cause I'm Sweepy the Magical Girl☆
And my dream is to become a true witch!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Once you become a witch, you can cast any magic you want!
With just one spell, you can turn a field into a sea of flowers,
cast a rainbow across the sky, or make shooting stars rain down!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No matter how wonderful it is,
magic can make it all possible♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(...! Chasing her dream with such confidence...
Even if it's being a witch, something that might seem so unrealistic to some—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (To believe so deeply, and speak with such burning passion—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (...Ngh, honestly, I... I want to, too—!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So, what about you? Do you want to be a witch,
or do you not? Which is it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I'm Zenno Rob Roy...!
My dream for the future is to become a hero—
just like 'Rob Roy'--!!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: A hero...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Ah...
Maybe I shouldn't have said anything...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—Then from now on,
you're one of us!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Because a witch and a hero make the ultimate team, naturally♪
I'll leave holding back the enemy to you, Rob Roy!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah—
...Yes! I look forward to working with you!
And—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No wayyy! The branch is stuck and won't come out!
If you're a hero, lend me a hand, Rob Royyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll help you right away!
...Fufu.
